title: From Broken to Bigger Than Yourself
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares an inspiring story of God's power to use the broken and the ordinary to accomplish extraordinary things. From breaking handcuffs on TV to filling massive stadiums around the world, Pastor Chris will show you that God only needs a willing heart to do a whole lot. You'll be challenged to consider if God is waiting on you to step out in faith and use what you have to make a difference.
